title: CrossCodex Ingestion HTML profile
description: Declares how one publisher marks up document structure in HTML, as CSS selectors (soupsieve syntax) and one regular expression. Operations run in this order: unwrap, remove, title, divisions, numbered_tables.

id.description: Registered name of the profile; the file must be named <id>.yaml. Lowercase letters, digits and '-'.

detect.description: The profile matches a page when this selector finds an element.

unwrap.description: Every match is replaced by its children.

remove.description: Every match is removed, subject to the balance guard on its tag name.

container.description: Element holding the document title (first match is used).

lines.description: Selector, relative to the container, for the title lines.

title.description: A div whose first element child matches this is a division.

exclude.description: A div matching this is never a division.

subtitle.description: Following siblings of the title that match are merged into the heading.

label.description: Regular expression the first cell's whitespace-normalized text must fully match.
